title: Conformity-Based Bayesian Projective Prediction
summary: We propose a general robust prediction framework, termed conformity-based projective prediction (CPP), that integrates Bayesian predictive modeling with ideas from conformity-based conformal prediction. Rather than assessing conformity through residual-based scores, the CPP criterion defines conformity distributionally: a candidate value for a future response is considered conforming to the extent that its inclusion in the data leaves the leave-one-out predictive distributions of the observed responses undisturbed.
